definitions.explanation: The upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee.

examples.japanese: スクワットで{太|ふと}ももを{鍛|きた}える。
examples.english: I train my thighs with squats.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{階段|かいだん}を{登|のぼ}ったら{太|ふと}ももが{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}になった。
examples.english: My thighs were sore after climbing a long staircase.

notes:
{太|ふと}もも refers to the thigh — the upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee. The word combines {太|ふと}い (thick/fat) with もも (thigh), literally "thick thigh."

WRITING:
Also written as {太腿|ふともも} in full kanji. The hiragana-mix spelling {太|ふと}もも is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}ももが{痛|いた}い: my thighs hurt
- {太|ふと}ももを{鍛|きた}える: to train/strengthen one's thighs
- {太|ふと}ももが{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}: thigh muscle soreness
- {太|ふと}ももの{裏|うら}: back of the thigh (hamstring area)

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ふくらはぎ: calf
- {膝|ひざ}: knee
- {脛|すね}: shin
- {腰|こし}: waist/hips
